messages:
monica: quick heads-up — ran a link-sweep against the runtime guide in staging, about 6 anchors returning 404 or redirect loops. unsure if this is docs content rot or staging preview CDN artifact. can someone owning runtime guide check?

anna: I can take initial ownership. can you drop the list here? i'll triage and open a patch PR for obvious 1-line fixes.

docs-bot: automated-scan: found 6 failures (anchors: /api#batching, /runtime/kv-cache, /deploy#canary, /images/runbook.png -> 403, /examples/old-curl -> 301, /faq#rate-limits -> 404). full report: https://internal-scans.example/scan/1778889999

jason: @anna FYI i saw the /examples/old-curl redirect earlier — that one came from the sample repo rename (examples -> samples). easy sed fix if you want.

anna: thanks. i'll handle old-curl and the anchor anchors. staging image 403 might be CDN token expiry; @ethan can you check staging asset permissions?

ethan: looking. staging CDN returned 403 for runbook.png; recent deploy rotated the preview token yesterday. i can re-upload to the staging bucket or update the signed-url TTL. which do you prefer?

anna: re-upload works for now — easier quick patch. can you put it under the runbook assets path so the relative path stays the same?

ethan: will do. uploading now, should be live in ~5m. i’ll post the new URL once done.

monica: timeline wise, if we can get 3 quick PRs (old-curl, anchor fixes, image rehost) today, we can include them in the docs sweep batch and avoid a follow-up sprint.

jason: i can review the old-curl PR once it's up. also can help with the /api#batching anchor — it's likely a header rename after the batching guide reformat.

anna: pushing PR for curl example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 — tiny sed and anchor update.

jason: :eyes: grabbing it now.

ethan: uploaded runbook.png to staging bucket and invalidated preview CDN. new path: https://staging-cdn.redwood/runbook/runbook.png (same relative path preserved).

anna: awesome, thanks. i'll re-run local preview and update the PR if needed.

docs-bot: scan-recheck queued — will re-run in 10m and post status.

monica: perfect. quick ask: can we add one-liner to the runtime guide about sample repo rename (examples -> samples) so future scans don't break anchors? even a note in the changelog section will help.

anna: will include that in a follow-up PR and add a tiny test link in the docs CI to catch 301s for known sample endpoints.

jason: super — thanks for owning this @anna. :thumbsup:

anna: np. ping me if anything else pops up.

monica: closing loop later. if scan still shows failures after recheck i'll escalate to ops. :white_check_mark:
